ideas.pitch: An agentic AI system that continuously scans cloud infrastructure logs and threat intelligence feeds to forecast zero-day vulnerabilities and compliance violations before they occur, featuring automated remediation playbooks.
ideas.title: AegisAgent: Autonomous AI Incident Forecaster for Critical Infrastructure
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Artificial Intelligence & Agentic AI and Cyber Security & Digital Forensics domains while mirroring proven winner mechanics from the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An automated enterprise sustainability tool that ingests supply chain invoices, shipping manifests, and IoT sensor streams to calculate, forecast, and optimize Scope 3 carbon emissions using graph neural networks.
ideas.title: SupplyLedger AI: Carbon Footprint and Scope 3 Emission Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the Sustainability & Climate Technology domain with a rigorous data-driven approach that provides clear, measurable environmental impact.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered HIPAA-compliant triage and patient acquisition platform that matches local patients with clinical trials by parsing unstructured electronic health records while preserving total data privacy.
ideas.title: MedFlow AI: Autonomous Clinical Trial Patient Matching and Trust Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Healthcare & MedTech domain and adopts the proven patient-trust acquisition framework from the Elevate X hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered transaction monitoring and Anti-Money Laundering platform that detects circular money laundering rings and high-risk wallet flows in real time using graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models.
ideas.title: GraphAML: Real-Time FinTech Risk Detection and Network Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits squarely into the FinTech & Digital Economy domain by directly reusing the winning architecture and explainability patterns of the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon champion.

ideas.pitch: A developer tool agent that integrates with GitHub and AWS/GCP to predict cloud infrastructure cost overruns and deployment failures prior to merging code, offering instant automated rollback patches.
ideas.title: DevPulse: Autonomous Cloud Cost and DevOps Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Cloud Computing, DevOps & Developer Tools domain by solving an immediate, daily pain point felt by every developer and judge in the room.
